t: This chrome mono basin pillar tap features easy, push-button operation, and a self-closing mechanism, designed for efficiency and durability. Ideal for commercial washrooms, public facilities, and busy trade environments where water conservation is crucial. Its robust brass construction ensures long-lasting performance, complemented by a polished chrome finish for a modern aesthetic. This water-efficient, deck-mounted tap is suitable for high-pressure systems and connects to hot or cold water supplies.
